segments.en:
The Battle of Axis ended
in a way no one had foreseen.

Axis, which had begun falling toward
Earth, changed its orbit due to a force
of unknown origin.

Having lost its strategic objective, the
Neo Zeon army ceased fighting, and the
battlefield fell into a temporary truce.

The commanders of both sides agreed to
put all their efforts, for the time being,
into rescue operations in the area.

With Supreme Leader
Char Aznable missing
in action,

all political settlements
were put off for later.

Another new Federation
fleet has appeared.

They say they're here to help
with the rescue. Let as many
come as they like!
Federation Konpei Island Fleet

All they have is numbers...
I'd hate to end up like that.
Quite right.

Has the Colonel still
not been found?

There have been no
such reports, sir!

He may still be on Axis...
Continue the search!

The other half of Axis is moving
away from the Earth Sphere.

If we pursue Axis now... it would be a
good excuse to pull our fleet out of
this area.

I considered that too... But even the
Federation can't be that incompetent...

You give them too much credit.
That's all the Federation is these days.

I suppose it's better
than doing nothing...

Form a detached unit
and send it to Axis!

Transfer as many troops as
possible to that fleet!

Understood.
We'll give it a try!

The Neo Zeon fleet
is on the move.

Some of their ships...
are leaving the battle line!

There's no need to pursue them.
Put everything into rescuing the men.
Roger!

My apologies for
the delay.
Rochina...

That band of light encircling
the Earth... Have you learned
anything?

Yes... Most likely, a new gate
has opened in that area.

A force strong enough to lift
the mass of Axis...
That's conceivable...

However, the reading is
rapidly getting weaker.

As I thought, natural forces alone
can't sustain it for long.

It seems different in nature from
the system we developed...
We are investigating it now.

The question now is where
that area leads to...

I've sent Omega. We should
get some kind of result.

Light!
You still haven't found anyone?

There's so much junk it's
hard to identify anything.

The longer this takes, the fewer
people we'll be able to save!

Your machines have sensors too,
you know. Search on your end!

Kaine!
Let's use our eyes too.

The D-3's sensors weren't built to
handle Minovsky particles, after all.
Exactly!

(What stopped Axis from
 falling... wasn't our
 own strength...)

(It was because some force beyond
 all common sense acted on Axis...)

(What on earth is that
 band of light...)

Hey!
One's headed your way!

Kanji! It's near you!
Probably an escape pod!

Got it.
Guide me in.
OK!
All right, I've got it.
Nice catch!

You really know your stuff.
We'll take over, Kanji!

Thanks. We're heading back to the
Ra Cailum for now. I'll leave the
rest to your squad, Kayra.
Ro~ger!

Hey, Kanji... Isn't this our chance
to check out the Konpei Island Fleet?

Sure, that fleet might
be Binzvanker's...

But right now they're
helping us save lives...

I don't want to stir up
trouble at a time like this.

Besides, right now... getting the
person out of that pod comes first.
Yeah, true...
I'm opening it.
Wh-What?!
You're...!
Nnnngh...

It's Quess!
No doubt about it!!

Thank goodness!
She's alive!

Hey!
Quess!!
Ugh...

...She looks pretty worn out.
Let's get her to sickbay right away.

She doesn't seem to be hurt,
but she's still not coming to...

She's exhausted, right? She must've
been through... a lot.

Come to think of it, we haven't
had a break in a while either...

Things are still tense outside.
We'd better rest while we can.

I'll call you when Quess comes to...
You guys go rest in your rooms.

Tapp!
What about you?

I'm the type who can sleep
anywhere... I'll rest here.
I see...

Alrighty, she's all yours,
Tapp ol' buddy!

H-Hey, are you sure
about this?

If he's watching her, there's
nothing to worry about.
Let's leave Quess to him!
See you later, Kanji.
Yeah...

rows.notes: [8] caption [jp] -> 'Federation Konpei Island Fleet' (Konpei Island per elf_strings telop). [3] [jp] -> 'the area'. [21] [jp] read as the detached fleet. segments.en: I'm still not sleepy...

No point just lying here.
Maybe I'll take a walk
around the ship...

Hm? There's a machine over
there I've never seen before.
This machine is...!

The Jagd Doga...
A mobile suit built for Newtypes.

It was left behind in the
wreckage of a Musaka.

Amazing... From the look of it,
it's hardly damaged at all.

Right now we're having it
tuned up so it can move.

Huh, so it works? Still, I can't
believe Neo Zeon would leave a
usable machine behind...

Maybe there was no pilot for it?
It's built for Newtypes, after all.

Or maybe their ship got hit and
they bailed in a hurry...
Yeah, probably something like that.
Built for Newtypes, huh...

If only Amuro or Chan
were here at a time like this...
Guess I should get some rest...

Rest
Not yet
Guess I'll get some rest...

A lot has happened since
I came out to space......

But... nothing that really
matters has been solved yet...

Nah...
I'm still not sleepy...

rows.notes: [1] choice pair [jp]/[jp] -> 'Rest' / 'Not yet', line structure kept.

segments.en:
Big Bro!
Big Brooo!!

Come on!
Get up already!!

Hnnngh!
Wake uuup!!
Waaaugh!!

Good morning,
Big Bro!

Today's finally the day
of the test voyage!

Huh...?
I-Is it...?

Geez...!
Are you still half asleep?

If the test voyage goes well, we're
heading straight out for the new
continent...!

Then we might not be able to
come back to this town for
a while!

I kno~w. But c'mon, there's still
time, right~? Let me sleep just
a little longer~

You really have zero sense
of urgency, Big Bro.

And just when we're about to start
the greatest undertaking of the
century...!

Ah! Geez~!
Big Bro!
I said no~!!
But I'm sleepy~

No~ way! I have to go
ahead for a meeting~

You can't get up on your
own, Big Bro!
I'll be fine~

Argh!
You're driving me crazy!!
Get up already! Geez!

We don't have time!
No time...
Huh...?
Wh-Wha~?
What's up... Rie?

Aha... ahaha...
It's nothing!

Oh, that's right, the
meeting time got changed.

I'll wake you later, so go
ahead and sleep in.
Ahahahahaha...

Don't. Tell. Me...
you mixed up day and night...
...or something like that~
Uh... ehehe...
Ri~e~~

Teehee~
Sorry~
Big Bro~
No way! You're not forgiven!

The next time I wake up... that'll be the
end of you! But... for now... I sleep~......
Bye then... Big Bro.
Hey, y'know~ Rie...
Hm?
Don't get too nervous.
Okay...!

So tomorrow's the day we set
out for the Sea of Clouds, huh...

That Rie...
She's trying way too hard...

Wait...
Something's off...

I feel like I'm forgetting
something important......
Where... am I again...?

Oh, whatever...
Somehow it feels
so warm and nice...
Lun...?

Hey!
Luuuun!

Luun!
Can't you hear me?
Huh...?
Kanji...?
Kanji... is that you?

Can't you see me?
I'm right in front of you.
Oh... you're right.

Kanji...
You're by my side, aren't you?
Lun... are you okay?

My feelings reached you,
just like this.
So I'm fine now.

But what about you, Kanji? What's
wrong? You seem a little down...
Y-You think so?
Mm-hm...

Hey,
what's the matter?
Hm?

I'm... giving it everything I've got,
but... am I doing the right thing...?

It feels like I'm drifting further and
further away from everyone in
Claudia...

Don't worry. Just keep moving
forward as you are, Kanji,
and you'll be fine.
You think so...

You're not wrong,
Kanji...

Calm your heart,
and believe in yourself.
I see...

Got it. I'll keep pushing forward
like this. Thanks, Lun.
Goodbye.
Ah!

Wait! There's still something
I want to tell you!
Lun!!
Luuun!!
Ah... a dream... huh......

Come to think of it... I wonder
what Lun's doing right now...

Is she living quietly,
like in that dream...?

And come to think of it...
Rie showed up too.

...Geez, why do I have to get woken
up by her even in my dreams?

Aaagh!
No, no, no!

I'm acting just like some
homesick little kid!

rows.notes: Rie's [jp] -> 'Big Bro' throughout. [17] Rie's third-person self-reference ([jp]) -> 'I'. [9] [jp] -> 'the new continent' (not in glossary; lowercase generic). [42] [jp] -> 'Cloud Sea' (per glossary Cloud Sea Observation Ship). [69] [jp] -> 'Claudia'. | [editorial 34] 'will be your end' awkward; natural spoken threat | [editorial 62] 'More importantly' translationese for [jp] (Lun turning from herself to him) | [editorial 87] [jp]: 'At this rate' implied progression; it is a comparison

segments.en:
Kanji!
You awake?

Yeah...
I just woke up.

Good. Then come to
sickbay right away.

Looks like Quess
has come to.

Got it.
I'll be right there.

...What did you say?!
Amuro and Char
are alive?!

Didn't you feel it? The two of them
flying out to the other side of the
light...

We were close by, but we
didn't notice anything...
Yeah...

I want to go after
those two right away!

I'm going to go talk
to Captain Bright!

Hold on a sec. Hathaway put himself
in danger to bring you back, you
know.

I know... But...
he's not on this
ship anymore, is he?

Yeah... He stole a Jegan that was
under maintenance, went out, and
hasn't come back since.

I think he's drifting somewhere
along with the machine.

That's not it. Hathaway thought I
was dead...... so he ran away...

He's not coming
back here...
H-How can you know that?

Finding Amuro should come first
for you guys too, shouldn't it!

There's no time!
Out of my way!
You should still be in bed!
Whoa!!
Amuro is alive?!

You'll see if you go! So please,
chase after Amuro with the
Ra Cailum!

I've heard Amuro talk about being
able to sense the will of the dead,
but...

That's not it!
Another world exists!

Kanji and the others
are proof of that.
Kanji and the others?

You've had a hunch too,
haven't you, Captain?

That Kanji and the others
aren't from this universe!

People who come back from Mars or
Jupiter are always suspected of
having ties to Zeon.

But they've done fine work
as regular crew members.

That's why I haven't
pried into their past.

Captain!
That's not what I mean!

Hey, Quess, you oughta
get some rest.

We've gotta head back out
for rescue work, so...

you rest in your
room, okay, Quess?

No way! I'm going
to see the Colonel!!
The Colonel?!

Kaine... I need to talk with
Captain Bright. Go on ahead.

Yeah, I know.
I'll leave the rest to you!
Right!

Now then, Princess,
right this way.

Hey! Don't you
touch me like that!

When you put it like that, it just
makes me wanna grab you even more!

Kyaaah!
Wh-What are you doing?!

Nooo!
Let go of me!!

I'd like Amuro to be
alive, too...

But from the way Quess talks,
I can't help but be convinced
that Amuro is dead...
I understand...

But... not everything Quess
is saying is wrong.

At least... not
when it comes to me...
What do you mean?
Well......

Ugh!
What's that?!
An enemy attack?!

rows.notes: [40] speaker header is Kaine (not Light) for the line answering Quess; kept as Kaine's. [36] [jp] / [jp] -> Kaine leaves the rest (Bright talk) to Kanji. [47] [jp] -> 'not when it comes to me'. | [editorial 14] word order: 'For you guys too, finding Amuro has to come first' was clunky

segments.en:
Quess blasted right
through the hatch!!

And on top of that,
she stole the Jagd Doga!!
You let her get away?!

Well~ she just slipped right out
of our hands. Wonder if she's
trained in something?

Come to think of it, she said
she'd trained in India or
something...

This is no time to be
talking about that!

Light!
Where's Quess going?!

She's close! Looks like she's
heading for La Vie en Rose.
Got it, I'm going right now!

Just so we're clear...
Quess is a Neo Zeon pilot.

I doubt it, but she might attack
us out of nowhere.
Let's approach carefully!
OK!

There's some kind of ship
attached to La Vie en Rose...

Oh, that's a Clop-class cruiser
that was abandoned when it couldn't
sail under its own power anymore.

Don't expect any cover
from that ship.

Better that way. We don't need
it starting some careless fight.

Whoa!
What the?!

This is La Vie en Rose!
Captain Diane has been
taken hostage!

Captain Diane and the culprit
have moved to the Clop
we're towing!

All right, we'll
board the Clop!

Getting into the ship
was easy enough...

Where'd that brat
go, dammit!

Hey! Isn't that
Quess's?
That thing...
She's moved to the bridge...

Quess... I believe what you told me.
So lower the gun.

No! Even if you believe me, that
doesn't mean you'd do the same
thing I would!

Kanji and the others...
looks like they've boarded.
Fire the engines!

Once we launch, we can't
correct our course!

That's fine, keep it like that...
Put us on an atmospheric
entry course, please!
Firing engines!
The ship's moving?!
Where's it going?
Don't tell me...!
This is reckless, Quess...

Captain! I'm taking this
scrapped ship!

What are you planning?!
With the damage that ship has...!

I know... That's why I want you to
record this ship as disposed of.
Please handle the paperwork.

Don't go deciding
things on your own!

Captain Bright,
I'm asking you too.

Ms. Diane,
not you too!

Captain Bright... the Dragonar Team
and I are not residents of this
universe.

Until now, we've been hiding our
identities by tampering with the
military's systems.

Then where on earth
did you come from?!

I'll explain that
myself later.

Right now there's no time!
Ending transmission!

What could lie beyond
that light...
Ms. Diane...
Hm?
Thank you!
It's all right.

Ms. Diaaane!
Are you all right?!!
Come on out, Quess!
We know you're in there!
Whoaaah!
Oof!
Owowowow...

Ahh~ what a bunch of
dopes you are~!

Why you little...!!
Give yourself up already!!

Hey!
What are you doing?!!

Hey!
Quit squirming!!

Kaine!
Stop that!
Owww!

What do you think you're doing
to a delicate lady!

Ms. Diane! If you take your eyes off
her, who knows what she'll do!

Now, calm down and listen
to what I have to say.

...So that's how it is.
I'm on Quess's side.

I don't know what lies beyond this
universe... but I think it's worth
going to see.

I'll stay here and tie
up all the loose ends.

But if things go wrong, we
might not be able to come back.

If we're going, you should
come with us, Ms. Diane.

I'm concerned about the Federation
fleet stationed at Konpei Island...

If it's a combined fleet with
Claudia, we need to keep
investigating it.

Kanji, if you had a Claudian ship,
you could come back here,
couldn't you?
Yes... Most likely...

But it's dangerous on
your own, Ms. Diane!

Bright will understand.
So I'll be fine!

If we get to this Claudia place,
things'll work out, right?
Then let's make up our minds and go!
Go for broke, huh...

Are you guys sure? It could be a long
trip. If it comes to it... I could
go alone...

Whoa, whoa...
Don't get all distant on us now.

We're buddies who've been
through the same hardships,
right?

True... If we're going to a new world,
we'll need the D-3's capabilities.

All right. But in exchange, you're
sticking with me till the very end.
That's the spirit!

Well then, I'll head back
to La Vie en Rose.

Um, Ms. Diane?
Can you pilot a launch?

Heh...! I'm an intelligence
agent, you know.
Oh, I see.

Kanji, take care of
those kids for me.

You be careful
too, Ms. Diane.
Thank you.
See you!

Well... this is where
things get tough.

All previous unit settings
have been cleared.

New unit data has been set,
centered on the Dragonar Team.

Alrighty!
Let's head out!!

Hathaway...
Sorry... I can't see
you right now...

Captain, are you sure
it's okay to let them
go like this?

They're the only ones who can
search for Amuro...
Let's leave it to them.

Understood. Let's keep a place
for them to come back to.

Sorry... I've ended up
dragging you all into
something strange.

What are you talking about?
This kind of thing is nothing
new for us.
Thanks...

The Ra Cailum will now put everything
into rescuing survivors.
Head for Point Alpha 42!

I'm counting on you...
Kanji.
